name: labs/ad-sdl__ot2_module
title: Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler (ot2_interface.OT2_Driver)
intro: Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler (ot2_interface.OT2_Driver), adapted from ad-sdl/ot2_module. It reads `robot_status`, `runs`, `active_run_id` and `active_run_status`; runs `start_protocol` and `stop_active_run`. `start_protocol`: upload an Opentrons protocol file that the operator overlay allows, create a run and send the robot's play action; the run continues on the robot after this action returns, until it ends or is stopped, and the protocol alone decides what the robot does in it. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__ot2_module --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__ot2_module --backend fake --mcp
